fault_rows.row: F1 powered, +/-12 V on the jack (input_continuous_fault_V)

adg5412f.basis: Within VSS - VT .. VDD + VT the switch passes the signal (Rev. C index 25, page 26, Power-On Protection); downstream 10 k + BAT54S unchanged

tmux7412f.basis: Survival: overvoltage only beyond the supplies by VT (SCDS404B index 32, 9.3.2.4). Signal passing is a separate condition: VT is 0.7 V typical at 25 C only (7.5), RON rises exponentially within 3 V of VDD (9.3.4), and no RON maximum exists at +/-12 V (7.6 is +/-15 V +/-10 %, VS = -10..+10 V). Usable signal range: VSS .. VDD - 3 V, i.e. -12 .. +9 V at nominal rails. VDD - 3 V is guaranteed only with VSS = 0 V (7.8: RON <= 15 ohm at 85 C for VS = 0..7.8 V, VDD = 10.8..13.2 V); at +/-12 V dual supply it is an extrapolation; see usable_signal_range

fault_rows.row: F2 powered, jack beyond a rail (rail sag or external source above +/-12 V)

adg5412f.basis: Switch turns off; source to +/-55 V, 80 V across the channel (index 25, page 26)

tmux7412f.basis: Switch turns off regardless of logic; source to +/-60 V, 85 V source-to-supply and source-to-drain (index 31, 9.3.2.1; index 32, 9.3.2.4)

fault_rows.row: F3 unpowered, rails at 0 V, GND present, +/-12 V on the jack

adg5412f.basis: Switch off, inputs high impedance, +/-55 V blocked (index 25, Power-Off Protection). Source leakage +/-40 uA typical only; drain leakage +/-50 nA max at 85 C (Table 1, index 2)

tmux7412f.basis: Sources Hi-Z, +/-60 V blocked (index 32, 9.3.2.2). IS(FA) grounded +/-125 uA is TYPICAL only (7.6 TYP column; no maximum), so source-side fault leakage has no guaranteed bound, as for ADG5412F. ID(FA) grounded +/-50 nA is a maximum at 85 C (7.6, index 6)

fault_rows.row: F4 unpowered, rails floating, GND present

adg5412f.basis: Off whether supplies are 0 V or floating (index 25). Floating drain leakage +/-10 uA typical only

tmux7412f.basis: Hi-Z with VDD/VSS 0 V or floating (index 32). Floating-rail leakage recorded as typical only (protection59-sources.json)

fault_rows.row: F5 GND absent (return open, board unplugged)

adg5412f.basis: Datasheet: a GND reference must always be present (index 25). Outside the protected envelope

tmux7412f.basis: Same requirement (index 32, 9.3.2.2). No regression from ADG5412F

fault_rows.row: F6 one analog rail missing, other present

adg5412f.basis: Single-supply operation 8..44 V is specified; an input outside the remaining span is an overvoltage and turns the switch off. Conditional on VDD - VSS >= 8 V for the on state

tmux7412f.basis: -12 V missing, +12 V present: PASS, VSS = 0 V is a specified single supply (VDD - VSS >= 8 V; 7.4, 9.1). +12 V missing, -12 V present: UNKNOWN, VDD = 0 V is below the recommended VDD minimum of 5 V (7.4) while the UVLO is defined on VDD - VSS = 12 V (7.5), so the device is not powered off by that definition and no datasheet text covers the state

fault_rows.row: F7 +5 V enable present before the analog rails (startup, R-ADG)

adg5412f.basis: Digital inputs tolerated without power; switch guaranteed off (index 25, Digital Input Protection); logic to 44 V

tmux7412f.basis: Fail-safe logic: logic before supplies, switch OFF, logic to +44 V (index 32, 9.3.2.3)

fault_rows.row: F8 rail lift: a patched input must not energize an unpowered rail (bare-clamp rejection)

adg5412f.basis: Source pins have specialized ESD with no diode path to the rails (index 24, ESD Performance)

tmux7412f.basis: Same statement: source ESD allows +/-60 V regardless of supply; powered-off protection prevents back-powering (index 32, 9.3.2.2 and 9.3.2.5)

fault_rows.row: F9 several inputs patched at once in one quad (ADG-1/ADG-3 packing)

adg5412f.basis: Rev. C index 24, page 25, Switch Architecture: "the channels undisturbed by the overvoltage input continue to operate normally without additional crosstalk"; 80 V channel stress (index 25). Project worst case 24 V. Qualitative manufacturer statement, no table limit

tmux7412f.basis: No published statement on undisturbed channels; only the 85 V source-to-drain stress rule (index 31) and -100 dB AC crosstalk. FF is shared across the four sources

fault_rows.row: F10 drain leakage and RON on pitch-sensitive inputs

adg5412f.basis: RON 14 ohm max, ID(on) +/-2.0 nA max at 85 C, +/-15 V table (Table 1); +/-12 V not guaranteed

tmux7412f.basis: Conditional: inside the usable signal range VSS .. VDD - 3 V (-12 .. +9 V at nominal rails) into the 100 k R_PD drain load. RON 14 ohm max and ID(ON) +/-2 nA max at 85 C exist in the +/-15 V +/-10 % table for VS = -10..+10 V (7.6); RON 15 ohm and RFLAT 0.5 ohm max at 85 C exist in the 12 V single-supply table for VS = 0..7.8 V (7.8, VSS = 0 V). Neither is a +/-12 V dual-supply guarantee. Above VDD - 3 V RON rises exponentially (9.3.4): UNKNOWN there
Orderable only as WQFN-16 RRP (addendum index 40); the TSSOP-16 PW package with the ADG pin order is marked Preview. New land and pin map: S1 = pad 1, D1 = pad 16, SEL1 = pad 15

usable_signal_range.basis: VSS .. VDD - 3 V at nominal +/-12 V rails (9.3.4). Guaranteed only with VSS = 0 V: 7.8 gives RON <= 15 ohm (-40..85 C) for VS = 0..7.8 V at VDD = 10.8..13.2 V. At +/-12 V dual supply the limit is an extrapolation, not a table condition. The fault detector opens the switch beyond VDD + VT / VSS - VT, VT 0.7 V typical at 25 C only (7.5)

roles.note: Verdict covers signal passing only. With the hold the driver only pulls SEL down through the BAT54S pull-down and the 100 k pull-up is clamped to +12V, so SEL <= VDD + 0.24 V at 25 C (VF max at 0.1 mA, hold current <= 54.5 uA) whatever the +5 V ramp; below 25 C UNKNOWN (no VF curve)

model.drift_definition: max over the role range (0.5 V steps) and the temperature span of |e(V,T) - e(V,25 C)|; cents at 1 V/oct (1 mV = 1.2 c)
model.before: BAT54S,215 typical Fig. 2 curves (project digitisation), log-interpolated in temperature and extrapolated below 25 C; no guaranteed bound exists
model.after_bound: (IR max at the top temperature + IR max at 25 C) x r_eff; BAV199 Fig. 4 curve (1) at VR = 75 V, assuming IR does not rise at lower VR or below 25 C; source is the JLCPCB-hosted mirror (UNSOURCED until a manufacturer-hosted copy is compared)
model.bootstrap: D_BOOT error r_eff x 2 Is sinh(VOS / Vt); its diode voltage is set by the follower, so it adds to and does not divert the BAV199 leakage term, which is unchanged. Typical drift uses Is = BAT54S typical IR at 1 V (an upper estimate) and |VOS| = 100 uV + drift x |T - 25 C|

opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.rows: SBOS737C 6.1 (index 4): signal input pins, common-mode (V-) - 0.5 .. (V+) + 0.5 V; current +/-10 mA. Footnote (1) is the general stress note; no footnote lets the voltage row be exceeded when the current is limited. 7.3.7 (index 24-25): the ESD steering diodes are intended to remain inactive in normal operation; current-limiting resistors and TVS are named only for EOS events. OPA4196 (S&H IN) has the same rows in SBOS869 6.1
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.reading: Both rows apply. The VDD .. VDD + VT window is therefore not PASS on the current row alone
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.declared_contract: With input_continuous_fault_V +/-12 V and the required load-rail minima (+12V 11.53 V, -12V 11.74 V) the jack exceeds the local rail by at most 0.47 V / 0.26 V: PASS against (V+) + 0.5 V with 0.03 V margin, independent of the clamp diode
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.beyond_contract_without_bootstrap: A source at the supply maximum (+12V 12.3 V at source) against a load rail at 11.53 V gives 0.77 V. Then SENSE - V+ <= min(VT, VF): BAT54S rail clamp VF <= 0.24 V at 0.1 mA, 25 C only; BAV199 VF has no maximum below 1 mA (UNKNOWN)

beyond_contract_with_bootstrap.bound: SENSE - V+ <= VF(D_BOOT) + I x ZO <= 0.24 + 0.026 = 0.266 V
beyond_contract_with_bootstrap.basis: The follower output limits at the rail (no phase reversal: OPA4197 SBOS737C 7.3.3 index 21, OPA4196 SBOS869 7.3.3 index 20). With the TMUX7412F drain inside its own absolute maximum (Dx <= VDD + 0.7 V, SCDS404B 7.1; beyond it the switch row fails first), I <= 70 uA through R_LIMIT and BAT54S VF <= 0.24 V (0.1 mA row, 25 C). ZO 375 ohm is the typical open-loop output impedance at 1 MHz (no maximum)
beyond_contract_with_bootstrap.verdict: PASS at 25 C (margin 0.23 V); below 25 C the BAT54S VF has no curve or maximum, so it is PASS only if VF rises by less than the margin (a Schottky tempco of about -1 to -2 mV/K, a general figure and not a BAT54S datasheet value, would add about 0.05 V at 0 C): UNKNOWN as a guarantee

opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.current_row: PASS: <= 70 uA, far below 10 mA; the follower output sinks or sources the same current
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.verdict_bav199_without_bootstrap: PASS within the declared contract; beyond it UNKNOWN
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.verdict_with_bootstrap: PASS within the declared contract; beyond it PASS at 25 C, UNKNOWN below 25 C (typical PASS)
opa4197_input_absolute_maximum.not_covered: Rail-missing and unpowered rows: with the follower unpowered D_BOOT clamps SENSE to the output pin, whose ESD diodes go to the dead rail; the BAV199 rail clamp is unchanged. Follower slewing: D_BOOT conducts while |SENSE - OUT| exceeds about 0.2 V during fast edges (transient only). NOT RUN
